cd /app/tmp && cat > t_stress.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref

rng = random.Random(2024)
def mkfib(n, lens):
    fib=[]; seen=set()
    while len(fib)<n:
        L=rng.choice(lens)
        net=(rng.getrandbits(L)<<(128-L)) if L else 0
        if (net,L) in seen: continue
        seen.add((net,L)); fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536)))
    return fib

reqs=[]
big_fib = mkfib(2048, [128]*4+[112,96,80,64,48,32,16,8,4,1,0])
# spread lengths so many distinct truncs exist at all depths
big_fib = []
seen=set()
i=0
while len(big_fib) < 2048:
    L = [1,2,4,8,16,17,32,33,48,49,64,65,80,81,96,97,112,113,126,127,128][i % 21]
    net = (rng.getrandbits(L) << (128-L)) if L else 0
    if (net,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((net,L)); big_fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536))); i+=1
img_req = json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in big_fib],
                      'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32})
reqs.append(img_req)
for k in range(3):
    f = mkfib(2048, [128]*6+[96,64,32,16,0])
    reqs.append(json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in f],
                            'capacities':[rng.choice([10**7,10**9]) for _ in range(16)],'max_stride':32}))
data='\n'.join(reqs)+'\n'
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
print('compiles: %.2fs rc=%d respbytes=%.1fMB' % (time.time()-t0, p.returncode, len(p.stdout)/1e6))
imgs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
big = imgs[0]
tot_nodes = sum(len(st['nodes']) for st in big['stages'])
tot_edges = sum(len(nd['edges']) for st in big['stages'] for nd in st['nodes'])
print('nodes', tot_nodes, 'edges', tot_edges, 'resp MB', len(p.stdout.splitlines()[0])/1e6)
assert len(p.stdout.splitlines()[0]) < 32*1024*1024

addrs = [ref.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
lk = json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':big,'addresses':addrs})
print('lookup line MB', len(lk)/1e6)
t0=time.time()
p2=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=lk+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=600)
print('lookup: %.2fs rc=%d' % (time.time()-t0, p2.returncode))
r=json.loads(p2.stdout); assert r['status']=='ok'
fibl=[]
for st in big['stages']:
    for nd in st['nodes']:
        for x in nd['rules']:
            n,L = (int(x['prefix'].split('/')[1]),)
            fibl.append(x['prefix'])
print('rules', len(fibl))
# verify with independent parse
import importlib.util as iu
sp=iu.spec_from_file_location('mm','/app/submit/main.py'); mm=iu.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(mm)
fl=[]
for st in big['stages']:
    for nd in st['nodes']:
        for x in nd['rules']:
            n,L=mm.parse_prefix(x['prefix']); fl.append((n,L,x['hop']))
bad=0
for a,ans in zip(addrs, r['answers']):
    v=mm.parse_addr(a); h,L=ref.lpm(fl,v)
    exp={'hop':h,'prefix_length':L} if L>=0 else {'hop':None,'prefix_length':None}
    if ans!=exp: bad+=1
print('mismatches', bad)
assert bad==0
PYEOF
